messages:
maria.partners: Hey — heads-up: we're planning a breaking SDK change that will touch partner marketplace listings and SI integrations. Need to align on timeline, partner communication, and marketplace update window. Proposal: deprecate the old sync batch endpoint and param (`POST /v1/batch_sync` + `wait=true`) and replace with `POST /v1/batch` (sync semantics removed). :wave:

devin.sdk: What semver are we calling this? Major (v4) for the SDKs. Recommended migration window = 90 days. Fast plan: partner-preview (30d), public deprec notice (60d), removal at 90d. :eyes:

ajay.sis: Quick flag — several SIs use an on-prem connector that expects `wait=true` behaviour. If we remove it outright some customers will break. Can we ship a compatibility shim in the runtime for Dedicated/Private?

lucy.pm: Communication notes: we should do a partner-only briefing (embargoed), provide a migration guide + sample code, and update marketplace listings so partners know when the SDK version will no longer be accepted. Also schedule an SI office hours slot.

ryan.legal: Reminder: for partners with signed MSA amendments we may need 60 days notice for breaking changes depending on the clause. I'll review the top 10 partners and flag any with extended notice requirements.

devin.sdk: We can add a temporary feature-flag `allow_legacy_batch` that accepts the old param for two minor releases (v4.0.x, v4.1.x) then remove. For hosted customers we'll emit a deprecation header `x-rdwd-deprecation: batch_sync; deprecated=2025-10-01`. For code samples, here's an example migration snippet:

```bash
# OLD
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch_sync -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"inputs": [...], "wait": true}'

# NEW
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"inputs": [...]}',
# synchronous behavior removed; move to asynchronous polling or websocket streaming
```

maria.partners: Good. For marketplace: partners need listing/docs updated at least 14 days before the partner-preview. Marketplace review takes about a week; so allocate 3 weeks total. For SIs we need 4 weeks to update connector repos and test on customer infra.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event 'Partner SDK Breaking Change Briefing' for 2025-07-15 16:00 UTC. Invites sent to maria.partners, devin.sdk, ajay.sis, lucy.pm, ryan.legal.

lucy.pm: I'll draft the partner-facing email + migration checklist. Will include: impact summary, exact dates, sample curl/snippets, fallback steps, contact for SI help, and a FAQ. Assigning TODOs: @devin.sdk add the compatibility shim ETA, @ajay.sis share top SI connector owners, @ryan.legal confirm notice windows.

devin.sdk: ETA for shim + release branch: 2 weeks. We'll cut a `v4-shim` branch and publish pre-release packages to npm/pypi for partners to try.

ajay.sis: I'll pull the list of connector owners and internal contacts by EOD tomorrow. Also recommend an SI-only test blackout window during the partner-preview so we don't accidentally rollout infra changes.

ryan.legal: Will push a short checklist of contracts to review by tomorrow noon. If any partner needs 90+ days we'll surface that here.

maria.partners: Action items summary:
- Partner briefing (2025-07-15) — deploy-bot created the event.
- Migration guide + sample code — lucy to draft, devin to add shim snippet.
- Marketplace listing update — maria + marketplace team, 3-week lead.
- SI coordination & connectors — ajay to list owners + blackout window.
- Legal notice check — ryan to confirm partner notice windows.

Any objections to the 90-day removal schedule?

devin.sdk: No objections from SDK side if shim ships and we provide pre-releases.

ajay.sis: No objections but need the shim for Dedicated/Private before partner-preview.

lucy.pm: Fine as long as we have the migration FAQ and a rollback plan.

ryan.legal: Fine pending contract reviews.

maria.partners: OK — proceeding with the plan. I'll post the partner briefing deck draft in this thread when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
